summary: Addex Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 8, 2026 press release disclosing that its spin-out company Neurosterix, in which Addex retains a 20% equity interest, completed Phase 1 clinical studies of NTX-253, an M4 receptor positive allosteric modulator for schizophrenia, and plans to advance it into Phase 2. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer operational update with no transaction, stake change, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or close date. What to watch: Neurosterix's Phase 2 progress and its effect on the value of Addex's minority 20% holding.
